description: Data pack enchantments with location based and ticking world effects (#305, I4-11): Stomp boots (location_changed) turn the grass around a player's and a zombie's feet into coarse dirt or podzol (replace_disk with a weighted state provider drawn from the entity's random) and make the grass two blocks south snowy (set_block_properties) whenever the block position changes or the boots change; a Pulse helmet (tick) spawns dust particles, plays a sound with a random pitch (random_chance from the level random) and every tenth tick runs a function that sets glowstone above the player (run_function as the player at its position).

actions.command: item replace entity steve armor.feet with minecraft:diamond_boots[minecraft:enchantments={"vanillite_test:stomp":2}]
item replace entity steve armor.head with minecraft:diamond_helmet[minecraft:enchantments={"vanillite_test:pulse":1}]
item replace entity steve armor.feet with minecraft:diamond_boots[minecraft:enchantments={"vanillite_test:stomp":1},minecraft:damage=5]
item replace entity steve armor.head with minecraft:air
